dramas.title: THE INFINITE 10 DAYS 十日终焉
dramas.description: A group of strangers from vastly different backgrounds wake up in the mysterious "Land of the End", where they are trapped in a deadly time loop that resets every ten days, each cycle erasing their memories. To escape, they must survive a series of perilous trials based on the twelve zodiac signs. As the cycles repeat, some begin to awaken supernatural powers known as "Echoes." Led by the brilliant Qi Xia, the group uses their unique abilities to battle enemies, unravel the truth behind the Land of the End, and fight for a way back home.

dramas.title: 2025 Legend of Zang Hai 藏海传
dramas.titleShort: Legend of Zang Hai 藏海传
dramas.description: The series tells the story of the son of the Chief Astronomer of the Great Yong Kingdom, who experienced the destruction of his entire family. Ten years later, he returns to the capital under the alias "Zang Hai," using the architectural skills and strategic prowess he has honed over the years to outwit the corrupt officials, uncover the conspiracy, and join forces with his beloved friends to defend the nation.

dramas.titleShort: Sunshine by My Side 骄阳伴我
dramas.description: This drama tells the story of an advertising director "Jian Bing" (played by Bai Baihe) and a newcomer designer "Sheng Yang" (played by Xiao Zhan) who meet by chance. The two people with completely different personalities gradually develop feelings for each other in their daily interactions.

dramas.title: 2022 The Oath of Love 余生，请多指教
dramas.titleShort: The Oath of Love 余生，请多指教
dramas.description: Gu Wei is a very solemn surgeon, although glimpses of his warm heart can be seen from time to time. As Zhi Xiao's father progresses through treatment, she and Dr. Gu become close—she helps him learn how to enjoy life, and he helps her focus on what she truly wants in life.

dramas.title: 2021 Ace Troops 王牌部队
dramas.description: From humble beginnings to forged bonds, two recruits - miner's son Gao Liang and military family scion Gu Yiye - clash over their differences, only to become comrades-in-arms. Through battles, demining in Guangxi, Hong Kong garrison, and the '98 flood relief, they weathered the military's transformation from mechanization to informatization. Their story is one of rivalry, camaraderie, and the unbreakable spirit of soldiers.

dramas.title: 2021 Douluo Continent 斗罗大陆
dramas.description: A gifted young man, Tang San (played by Xiao Zhan), and his alcoholic father, Tang Hao, forge an unbreakable bond. As Tang San's martial soul awakens, his father reveals a secret about his mother. Determined to fulfill his promise, Tang San enrolls at Nuoding Academy and Shrek Academy, where he and six other talented youths form the Shrek Seven Devils. Through trials and tribulations, they uncover a sinister plot by the Martial Soul Hall, ultimately emerging victorious and becoming the pinnacle of the Douluo Continent.

dramas.title: 2020 The Wolf 狼殿下
dramas.description: A young wolf raised in the pack is mistaken for a murderer and hunted relentlessly. Though the truth is uncovered, a sibling's interference leads the wolf to believe the noblewoman has betrayed him. He vanishes, only to be secretly adopted by a passing traveler. Years later, they reunite, their past misunderstandings unraveling a new tale.
